# Synthetic Prowlarr API v1 fixtures

Hand-authored 2026-09-24 against the published Prowlarr development OpenAPI contract (API 1.0.0). No installed Prowlarr version or live server has been verified. The fixture covers GET `/api/v1/system/status`, `/health`, `/indexerstatus`, and `/indexer` with `X-Api-Key` header authentication (value never recorded). It includes a deliberately nested secret canary in provider fields; the adapter must project only IDs, names, enable flags, status timestamps, and generic health severity. Empty, unauthorized, timeout, malformed and oversized cases are generated by tests. Application connectivity stays unknown; `/applications` and active test routes are not read.
